title: DNS Phase 0 projection engine and observation-mode reconciler
intended_behavior: Derive DNS endpoints statelessly from healthy/in-sync service state, LLM route state, ML inference state, and online workers.
Project one A, AAAA, or CNAME record per endpoint using configured environment and worker zone mappings.
Detect duplicate endpoint coordinates and fail the projection snapshot.
Reconcile projected zone snapshots to configured DNS backends without publishing DNS events in Phase 0.
observed_repository_context: DNS domain and config contracts are present from WI-1.
LLMRouteReconciler provides the periodic Run/ReconcileOnce pattern followed by DNSReconciler.
Existing ServiceRepository, EnvironmentRepository, EnvironmentServiceStateRepository, and RuntimeObservationRepository provide service projection inputs.
out_of_scope: DNS backend adapter implementations from WI-2.
Application wiring and Nostr endpoint publication from WI-4.
SRV, TXT, weighted, capability alias, and DNS policy projection.
